title: Operationalizing the EU AI Act in Agile Software Development: A Guideline-Based Approach
abstract: arXiv:2608.16526v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Context: The EU AI Act requires providers and deployers of Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems to implement documentation, risk management, and human oversight. Agile teams that ship AI features in short iterations lack specific artifacts to discharge these duties, since the regulation's abstract provisions do not map onto the Definition of Done, Sprint Reviews, or working agreements. Objective: We provide agile teams with an actionable compliance instrument: an evaluated guideline that operationalizes EU AI Act obligations as activities integrable into existing agile practice. We further document the translation method behind it so that the approach can be reused for adjacent regulations. Method: Following Design Science Research, we assessed each EU AI Act article along three dimensions. translated_title: 在敏捷软件开发中实施欧盟人工智能法案：一种基于指南的方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16526v1 公告类型：新 摘要：背景：欧盟人工智能法案要求人工智能系统的提供者和部署者实施文档记录、风险管理和人工监督。以短迭代交付人工智能功能的敏捷团队缺乏具体的工件来履行这些职责，因为法规的抽象条款无法映射到“完成定义”、冲刺评审或工作协议上。目标：我们为敏捷团队提供一种可操作性的合规工具：一份经过评估的指南，将欧盟人工智能法案的义务转化为可整合到现有敏捷实践中的活动。我们还记录了其背后的翻译方法，以便该方法可被重复用于相邻法规。方法：遵循设计科学研究，我们沿三个维度评估了欧盟人工智能法案的每条条款。随后，我们使用交通灯方案对条款进行分类，并将那些被判定为高度相关的条款映射到先前记录的痛点中。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于指南的方法，将欧盟人工智能法案的义务转化为敏捷开发中可执行的活动，以帮助敏捷团队在短迭代中实现合规。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a guideline-based approach that translates EU AI Act obligations into actionable activities in agile development, enabling agile teams to achieve compliance in short iterations.
